notes: NEW: SEASON 2 - HARVEST (BETA). Starts Jan 1: a new 100-tier battle pass with 106 new items - camos, charms, stickers, calling cards and the REAPER'S HARVEST skin at tier 100. Free during beta.
Your Season 1 items stay yours forever. The menu counts down the last 7 days of a season, and a popup tells you when the new one starts.
NEW: SAVE CODES. Settings > ACCOUNT > YOUR SAVE makes a code (or a file) with all your progress. Paste it on another PC to load it.
NEW: BLOCK PLAYERS. Block from the pause menu player list - you won't see their chat, hear their voice or get their invites. Manage the list in Settings > ACCOUNT.
NEW: WORD FILTER for chat and names (on by default, Settings > ACCOUNT > SAFETY).
NEW: ERROR REPORTS. If a red error ever shows, it now has COPY REPORT and HIDE buttons. Settings > ACCOUNT > HELP shows recent errors.
FIX: the event progress could show NaN/3.
